signal: Minitab acquired Scytec in January 2026 to add real-time machine data collection to its manufacturing analytics suite.

email.body1:
Nicole, saw Minitab folded Scytec into the platform to push deeper into real-time manufacturing data.

A bigger product footprint usually means more in-market accounts than the academic and commercial teams can actually touch, and that gap is where deals quietly go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without adding reps: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Minitab off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Nicole, quick follow-up for Minitab.

After an acquisition the territory map expands faster than the team can, and most leaders don't actually know how many meetings each rep needs to cover the new accounts. The gap tends to surface late in the quarter, when it is hardest to fix.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Minitab needs to keep the new footprint covered without hiring a wave of reps.
email.body3:
Nicole, last bit of proof for Minitab.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Minitab's reply rate likely compares to similar B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Nicole, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority while you integrate Scytec, no problem at all. Post-acquisition quarters are their own kind of busy, and timing matters more than anything here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Minitab either way.
